ask: Turn our launch notes into an X thread, with the dashboard screenshot on the last part: https://cdn.example.com/dashboard.png. The notes: the new dashboard shipped today; every number links to the posts behind it; results load in under a second; exports work on mobile. Last launch got a pile of spam replies.

steps.why: The account's character limit, once. Each part counts on its own.

contents.content: We shipped the new dashboard today. Three things changed.
1. Every number now links to the posts behind it.
2. Results load in under a second. 3. Exports work on mobile.

steps.why: The decision: a thread, not one post, because there are three separate points and each part stands alone; 3 parts, hook first, the screenshot where it pays off. Parts only go in through bulk-create-posts as a nested contents list; media inside a part is media_url. Poll bulk-create-status for the created_post_id.

The user's spam worry decides the value: followers means only accounts the brand follows can reply, which suits a launch. A batch item carries no settings, so it is set on the saved post; the details call refuses a misspelled value. The parts chain as replies either way.
Read back reply_settings before saying the thread is set.

say: Saved to Acme as a draft X thread: part 1 is the post, parts 2 and 3 go out as replies, with your screenshot on part 3. Only accounts you follow can reply. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it, or change a part?
never: create-post for a thread: it saves part 1 only.
A poll in the thread: Bolta refuses it.
A video on X: it takes images only.
Saying the thread is fully out without checking: a part that fails stops it, and the parts already out stay up.
